title: No allocation symbol
body: nm -D --undefined-only build/release/libuuid7.so
criteria: None of malloc, calloc, realloc, free, aligned_alloc, posix_memalign is referenced.

title: Runtime dependencies
body: readelf -d build/release/libuuid7.so
criteria: The only NEEDED entry is libc.so.6.

title: Static footprint
body: nm -S on the release object app__uuid7.c.o
criteria: Exactly g_v7_state, g_uuid_rng_func and g_clock_failures, 8 bytes each, in .bss.

title: Test seams absent from delivery
body: nm -D --defined-only build/release/libuuid7.so
criteria: No uuid7_test_ symbol.

title: Warning-free build
body: grep "warning:" in the six build logs of the pipeline
criteria: No warning in build/pipeline/build_*.log.

title: Code coverage
body: gcovr summary of the coverage run of the integration and scenario suites
criteria: line_percent >= 80 and branch_percent >= 65; uncovered lines justified by UUID7-IN-001 and UUID7-IN-002.

title: Public symbol prefix
body: nm on the release archive: every global symbol defined by libuuid7.a
criteria: Every defined global symbol starts with uuid7_.

title: Reproducible packages
body: utils/build_deb.sh run again after the pipeline's package stage
criteria: The two SHA256SUMS are identical.

title: Platform-agnostic includes
body: #include lines of app/uuid7.c
criteria: Only C library and POSIX headers, uuid7.h and (test builds) uuid7_test.h.

title: Documented interface
body: doxygen warnings for app/uuid7.h (WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED, WARN_NO_PARAMDOC)
criteria: No warning.

title: Burst capacity
body: Analysis of the reservation rule: 4096 sequence values per logical millisecond; a reservation is refused only beyond now + UUID7_MAX_AHEAD_MS.
criteria: With the clock frozen, 4096 x (UUID7_MAX_AHEAD_MS + 1) identifiers are issued before the first refusal, 40,960,000 of them ahead of the wall clock with the default bound.

title: Lock-free reservation
body: Analysis of uuid7_gen() and _ensure_rng_func(): the atomics used and the retry condition.
criteria: No lock, sleep or wait; uuid7_gen() retries only after a failed weak compare-and-swap; the built-in RNG is stored by a strong compare-and-swap from NULL only.

title: Entropy source
body: Inspection of _default_rng().
criteria: getrandom(2) loop with EINTR retry; /dev/urandom opened O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC for the unfilled suffix, read with EINTR retry; every failure path zeroes the unfilled bytes and closes the descriptor it opened; without __linux__ only /dev/urandom is read.
notes: verdict=passed; date=2026-10-10; by=maintainer; verifies=UUID7-SRS-019 UUID7-SRS-025 UUID7-SRS-070 UUID7-SRS-080

title: Clock failure path
body: Inspection of _get_realtime_ms(), uuid7_gen() and _raise_g_v7_state_from_uuid().
criteria: On clock_gettime() failure the count increments and 0 is returned; uuid7_gen() then continues from the state and skips the ahead bound (the 48-bit limit still applies); the import skips the bound.

title: Static assertions
body: grep of the _Static_assert block of app/uuid7.c
criteria: CHAR_BIT == 8, UCHAR_MAX == 255, sizeof(uint8_t) == 1 and sizeof(uint64_t) == 8 are asserted.

title: Error reporting
body: Inspection of every return path of app/uuid7.c.
criteria: Failures return -1 to -4; no abort(), no assert(), no signal, no errno contract; the reservation state is written only by a successful compare-and-swap.

title: Initial state
body: Inspection of the static initialisers of app/uuid7.c.
criteria: g_v7_state = 0, g_uuid_rng_func = NULL, g_clock_failures = 0.

title: RNG callback contract
body: Inspection of uuid7_rng_function_t and of its only call site, _fill_random().
criteria: The callback is called with (buf, 8) once per uuid7_gen(); any non-zero return makes uuid7_gen() return -2.

title: Build-time configuration
body: Inspection of the #if/#ifdef/#ifndef directives of app/uuid7.h and app/uuid7.c.
criteria: UUID7_MAX_AHEAD_MS is the only overridable macro that changes behaviour; UUID7_TESTING selects the test seams, __linux__ the entropy source.

title: Coding standard
body: The format stage (clang-format 18) and an inspection of app/ against the rules of ecss/PAF/CODING_STANDARD.md that no gate enforces: F3, N2 to N5, D1, D4, E1, E2, E4, C1, C2.
criteria: Format stage ok; no deviation found.

title: Binary-only interface
body: Review of app/uuid7.h.
criteria: No text function, no char buffer parameter; identifiers cross the interface as 16 bytes.

title: No disclosure beyond identifiers
body: Review of app/uuid7.h.
criteria: No accessor of the reservation state or of the RNG; uuid7_clock_failure_count() is the only state accessor.

title: ABI gate
body: Pipeline stages abi (abi/layout.txt against the header) and abi-exports (exports of libuuid7.so).
criteria: Both stages ok.

title: Hardening gate
body: utils/check_hardening.sh build/release/libuuid7.so build/release/libuuid7.a
criteria: "all hard checks passed".

title: Packages
body: Pipeline stage package (utils/build_deb.sh).
criteria: Stage ok; build/debs holds libuuid7, libuuid7-dev, SHA256SUMS and one .buildinfo per deb.

title: Installed-package smoke test
body: tests/package/smoke.c compiled against the debs extracted into build/smoke (pipeline stage package-smoke).
criteria: Stage ok.

title: Generation cost benchmark
body: tests/stress/stress.c in every profile x linkage cell (pipeline stage stress-run).
criteria: The release/static cell passes and its mean cost per uuid is <= 100 ns.
